messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Mutual action plan: performance readout & close timeline — streaming TTFT report

Hi Ryan / Aisha,

Thanks again for taking time last week. Per our call I put together a short mutual action plan to validate streaming performance and time-to-first-token (TTFT) for your chat flows so we can finalize sizing and close the pilot by end of month. Attachments: WS_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP skeleton) and benchmark-instructions-v2.pdf (runbook we used).

Key objectives:
- Measure TTFT (time-to-first-token) and streaming latency at p50/p95/p99 for typical user prompts
- Validate concurrency & throughput targets: 50, 200, 500 concurrent sessions
- Confirm token/sec throughput under batching and KV-cache scenarios
- Surface any quality regressions vs baseline prompts

Proposed evaluation plan (high level):
1) Data & prompts — you provide a representative sample of 200 session transcripts (anonymized) by EOD Thu 8/17.
2) Baseline run — Redwood runs the hosted instance with your prompt set across the 3 concurrency tiers. We capture TTFT and streaming percentiles, token throughput, error rates.
3) Variant runs — we run with prefix/KV caching and with quantized model variant; report delta to baseline.
4) Readout & SLA mapping — consolidated p50/p95/p99 table + recommended deployment profile for production (Dedicated vs Hosted).

Timeline we propose:
- 8/17: receive prompts/data from WellSight
- 8/18: baseline tests (low concurrency) + share interim numbers
- 8/19-8/20: full concurrency sweep + variant runs
- 8/21: MAP readout and recommendations; finalize pilot contract and commit date

Asks for you: please confirm the sample dataset timeline and share any compliance redlines for the test VPC/data handling. If that timeline works I’ll lock test windows and assign SE time (Monica) to run the bench.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: performance readout & close timeline — streaming TTFT report

Hi Ryan / Aisha — we ran the baseline and variant sweeps this morning using the dataset you delivered. Summary here (baseline = Redwood-hosted gpt-open-14b, sequence length trimmed to 512 tokens):

Baseline (no caching, continuous batching target=64):
- TTFT (time-to-first-token) p50: 220 ms, p95: 720 ms, p99: 1.05 s
- Streaming latency (first byte to subsequent bytes) p50: 45 ms, p95: 140 ms, p99: 320 ms
- Concurrency sweep (observed at 500 concurrent sessions): average token throughput per GPU: ~3.6k tokens/sec, error rate 0.6% (timeouts at peak bursts)

With prefix/KV caching enabled (simulated warm start for 40% sessions):
- TTFT p50: 120 ms, p95: 330 ms, p99: 620 ms
- Streaming p95 improved to 95 ms
- Error rate dropped to 0.2% at 500 concurrency

Quantized variant (int8) — lower throughput but similar TTFT tail: p95 ~800 ms at 500 concurrency.

Files attached: wellsight-bench-results.csv (per-request latency logs), quick-readout.html (lightweight charts). Early observations: caching gives the biggest delta on TTFT tail; batching helps throughput but can increase p50 slightly under low qps. We recommend a hybrid: enable KV cache for conversational sessions and configure burst autoscaling to handle peak 500 concurrency windows.

Next steps we propose:
- 8/18 afternoon: review the CSV and charts together (I’m available 4–5pm PT)
- 8/19: run a Dedicated-profile simulation if you want a production SLA table (this will add ~1 business day)

Let me know a time for the readout.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Ryan / Aisha — great work, Monica, and thanks Ryan for the quick turnaround. Quick summary and close timeline so we have alignment: 

Summary of readout:
- Baseline p95 TTFT: 720 ms; p99: 1.05 s
- KV cache reduced p95 TTFT to ~330 ms and p99 to ~620 ms for ~40% warm sessions
- At 500 concurrent sessions, hosted profile achieves ~3.6k tokens/sec per GPU with small increase in tail under peak bursts; Dedicated will improve headroom and reduce timeouts.

Proposed close steps:
- 8/19: joint readout with WellSight engineering (Monica will demo charts) — confirm 4pm PT
- 8/20: Dedicated-profile simulation run (optional) and procurement draft sent to Aisha
- 8/24: target internal signoff at WellSight; Redwood to issue pilot SOW and a 30% usage credit to offset the Dedicated simulation runs

Please confirm the 8/19 4pm PT readout and I’ll send a calendar invite + the readout deck. Once we align on the Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation we can finalize the commit and paperwork.
